commands.command: TBD: run objective-only no-wheel hidden-envelope optimization with decoupled per-target heads or alternating target-balanced minibatches across at least three repeated seeds
commands.name: m96_planned_per_target_objective

decision_rule: Only admit a hidden-envelope objective for PPO if braking yaw and lateral normal-vs-reset lift are all positive after optimization across repeated seeds.
failure_criteria: one target improves by sacrificing another target
formal seeds use target-specific tuning after seeing results
normal hidden is not compared to same-frame reset hidden
behavior PPO starts before the objective-only pass is stable
hypothesis: A decoupled per-target hidden-envelope objective can keep the M95 braking gain while preventing lateral and yaw regressions.
success_criteria: objective decouples braking yaw and lateral losses more strongly than M95
same hyperparameters are reused across repeated formal seeds
all three future-envelope targets have positive after-lift against reset hidden
result is documented before any PPO continuation
